title.narrative: UNDP Initiation plan to strengthen public management
UNDP Initieringsplan för att stärka den offentliga förvaltningen

description.narrative:
Overall objective:
The overall objective of the intervention is to accompany transition stage of the elected authorities to preside over the Executive Branch with precise and organized data and evidence on sustainable development and the most significant social processes taking place in the country, optimizing the available resources to enable the new administration to achieve the strategic goals considered in its government plan in the shortest possible time. Specific objectives:
- Promoting the development of an orderly and efficient plan for the transition of governmental periods, that allows the public administration strengthening.
-To have up-to-date and relevant information on the most urgent problems that have recently affected the country.
-To provide inputs allowing to identify different contextual processes that are causing profound changes in the economy, society, the environment and the livelihoods of the Guatemalan population.
- Laying the groundwork for the immediate treatment of the larger problems affecting Guatemala.
